title: VisDoM Page-Region Hard Negative Retriever
descriptionMd: Train a lightweight retrieval adapter that reranks candidate pages/regions using OCR text plus coarse visual layout features, with hard negatives mined from visually similar but semantically different pages. The scope is limited to improving top-k visual document retrieval for multimodal RAG without changing the generator.

sourceSnapshot.sourceNote: dataset_eval_protocol:End-to-end answer accuracy with top-k retrieved pages as context

structuredIdea.title: VisDoM Page-Region Hard Negative Retriever
structuredIdea.description_md: Train a lightweight retrieval adapter that reranks candidate pages/regions using OCR text plus coarse visual layout features, with hard negatives mined from visually similar but semantically different pages. The scope is limited to improving top-k visual document retrieval for multimodal RAG without changing the generator.
structuredIdea.research_direction: Use the VisDoM benchmark as the primary testbed and add a small reranking module over baseline text/vision embeddings. Compare plain embedding retrieval vs. layout-aware reranking with mined hard negatives.
dataset_eval_protocol_refs: End-to-end answer accuracy with top-k retrieved pages as context
structuredIdea.expected_advantage: Should reduce confusions between visually similar pages and improve top-k retrieval quality with minimal model and engineering overhead.
risk_points: May overfit to VisDoM layout patterns
Hard-negative mining may be noisy if OCR is weak
Gains may be small if the baseline retriever is already strong
